from itertools import combinations

ruler = [0, 1, 3, 7, 12, 20]
print(f"Golomb Ruler: {ruler}")
print(f"Number of marks: {len(ruler)}")
print()
print("Pairwise distances (all must be unique):")
distances = {}
for i, j in combinations(ruler, 2):
    d = j - i
    distances[(i,j)] = d
    print(f"  {j} - {i} = {d}")

all_dists = list(distances.values())
print(f"\nAll {len(all_dists)} distances are unique: {len(all_dists) == len(set(all_dists))} ✓")
